# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About XR-221 Spaceport Radio
Paid to Play is a gaming-focused platform that rewards users for playing games, suggesting a play-to-earn or incentivized gaming model. The brand likely appeals to casual and competitive gamers who enjoy being compensated for their time and skill. The existing Wix site provides a starting point, and the new site should capture the excitement, fun, and earning potential central to the platform's value proposition.

## Target Audience
- gamers who want to earn rewards or money by playing games
- Reward-Seeking Gamers
- Competitive Gamers
- Part-Time Streamers

## Industry
